snapshots.name: an empty name is no name
a text role ignores its name
leaf with text and a name
string and node children
snapshots.yaml:
- paragraph:
  - text: "Read the "
  - link "docs":
    - /url: /docs
  - text: " first."

snapshots.name: disabled, expanded, active
snapshots.yaml:
- button "a" [disabled]
- button "b"
- combobox "c" [expanded]
- combobox "d"
- textbox "e" [active]
- textbox "f"

snapshots.name: iframe nodes render as they are
nested lists
snapshots.yaml:
- list:
  - listitem:
    - text: One
    - list:
      - listitem: One.a
      - listitem:
        - link "One.b" [ref=e7]:
          - /url: /b
  - listitem: Two

snapshots.name: several top-level nodes
snapshots.yaml:
- banner:
  - heading "Site" [level=1]
- main:
  - paragraph: Body
- contentinfo: © 2026

snapshots.name: a form, as an ai snapshot prints it
snapshots.yaml:
- generic [ref=e1]:
  - heading "Sign in" [level=2] [ref=e2]
  - textbox "Email" [active] [ref=e3]:
    - /placeholder: you@example.com
  - textbox "Password" [ref=e4]
  - checkbox "Remember me" [checked] [ref=e5]
  - button "Sign in" [ref=e6] [cursor=pointer]
  - link "Forgot password?" [ref=e7] [cursor=pointer]:
    - /url: /reset

snapshots.name: a table
snapshots.yaml:
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "Name Qty":
      - columnheader "Name"
      - columnheader "Qty"
  - rowgroup:
    - row "Apples 3":
      - cell "Apples"
      - cell "3"

snapshots.name: deep nesting
snapshots.yaml:
- group "level 1":
  - group "level 2":
    - group "level 3":
      - group "level 4":
        - group "level 5":
          - group "level 6":
            - group "level 7":
              - group "level 8":
                - group "level 9":
                  - group "level 10":
                    - group "level 11":
                      - group "level 12":
                        - button "Deepest" [ref=e99]
                        - text: after 12
                      - text: after 11
                    - text: after 10
                  - text: after 9
                - text: after 8
              - text: after 7
            - text: after 6
          - text: after 5
        - text: after 4
      - text: after 3
    - text: after 2
  - text: after 1
